name: Knowledge Management for Beginners
contents: **10+ hours** of video content across **9 comprehensive modules**
**Systems-first approach**: build sustainable systems, not quick hacks
**Tool-agnostic principles** that work with any software you choose
Built from **20+ years** of real-world practice
Complete PKM Process: Explore → Curate → Consume & Capture → Distill, Organize & Connect → Develop → Create → Share
Start simple, build gradually; no need to change everything at once
Deep dive into methods: *PARA*, *Johnny Decimal*, *Zettelkasten*, *LIFT*, *FILE*, and more
**PKM Proficiency Ladder**: 9 levels from basic note-taking to AI-powered knowledge mastery
Real-world examples with detailed walkthrough of creator's **10,000+ note** vault
**Bonus resources**: Example vault, templates pack, slides, **2K+ concept knowledge base**
**Lifetime access** with all future updates included
**Community support** to connect with fellow learners
